author: J-Nirosha
title: Sampling
body:
When I researched about sampling, there were two categories Probability sampling and non probability sampling. If we have both probability and non probability sampling and probability is the one where everyone will have an equal chance of being selected why would anyone go  for non probability sampling? We would know that the result from non probability is definitely more biased when compared to probability sampling. 
I don't understand where exactly i would need to use non Probability sampling because anyone would want a less biased answer only.

comments.author: J-Nirosha
comments.body:
Please ignore. I got the answer.
When we need to explore or understand a problem → Non-probability can be useful
